Type: lift-top coffee table
Use: holding drinks, eating or working from the sofa, storage; living room
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: wood composite with a smooth espresso wood-grain finish
Colors: warm reddish dark brown
Shape: rectangular top that lifts up, deep apron, open lower shelf split in two cubbies, square tapered legs, medium and solid
Feel: practical, warm, homely
Goes with: beige or grey sofas, cream walls, warm wood; traditional or family living rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Lift-top Coffee Table, Espresso
product.description: Coffee table with top that lifts to create a sturdy, raised work surface; ideal for a living room, family room, or office Hidden storage space beneath the lift-up top—plenty of room for a throw blanket, remote controls, board games, and more Made of sturdy wood with an Espresso finish; finished on all sides, which allows for versatile placement Open shelves below offer added storage and display space Measures 40 by 18 by 19 inches (LxWxH); weighs 39 pounds; backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
